findings.title: Server accepted message with missing required field
findings.description: Removing field "action" from the message did not cause rejection, suggesting the server does not validate required fields.
findings.remediation: Implement strict schema validation for all incoming messages; reject messages with missing required fields.

findings.title: Server accepted message with wrong field type
findings.description: Changing the type of field "action" did not cause rejection, suggesting weak type validation.
findings.remediation: Validate field types strictly; reject messages where field types don't match the expected schema.

findings.title: Server accepts messages with unexpected extra fields
findings.description: Adding unexpected fields (__admin, __debug, __internal_role) did not cause rejection.
findings.remediation: Reject messages containing unexpected fields; use strict schema validation with allowlisted field names.

findings.title: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH): Origin not validated
findings.description: The server accepted a WebSocket connection with a spoofed Origin header. Connection with Origin 'https://evil.com' was accepted. An attacker could exploit this to connect from a malicious website.
findings.remediation: Validate the Origin header on WebSocket upgrade requests; reject connections from untrusted origins.
